notes.title: Patch 1.1.1
notes.content:
[b]FIXES:[/b]
[olist]
[*] The Swamp:
     Removed a glitch that made entering the Manufactory(the second building) impossible.
     Removed a glitch that made the zombies unable to walk through some doors.
     Overall collision improvements around the map.
[*] 
[*] Optimization:
     Removed experimental features that killed performance.

[*] Texts: 
     We've removed the unintelligible garbage from the tutorials.

[*] WMR Support: Controller bindings for WMR is now fixed.
[/olist]

[b]NEW ADDITIONS[/b]

[olist]
[*] Tutorial:
     We've done a complete rework of our tutorial. The new tutorial features a full voice-over, has a more simplistic approach and it's fun.

[*] Melee Combat & Weapon Holstering:
     Melee combat adjustments made to damage/swing velocity balance. Now it feels more natural to hit something rather than killing air.

Weapon holstering is changed. To better visualize if your weapon is going to be stored or not now you'll see an outline of your weapon if you put it on your belt.

The quick draw area is enlarged. With this picking up weapons from your holster will be much easier than before.
[/olist]

Once again we're very sorry about the rocky start. But as we said from day one this is a passion project for us, we're not disheartened and we're going to make Buried Alive: The Annihilation VR meet its full potential.

Thank you for sticking with us this far,

-The Two Ravens

notes.title: After the Tough Release: What's Our Plan of Action
notes.content:
Hello Annihilators,

Since our release two days ago we've seen that many of you had some problems with the game whether it's big or small. We're deeply sorry for the bad experience you had with the game and we're grateful for your honest and direct feedback. 

After the full two days of data collection, today we'll be talking about what's being fixed, coming, and added with the new patch. Without further ado let's take a look:

[b]FIXES:
[/b]
[olist]
[*] The Swamp: 
Removed a glitch that made entering the Manufactory(the second building) impossible.
Removed a glitch that made the zombies unable to walk through some doors.
Overall collision improvements around the map.

[*] Optimization:
Removed experimental features that killed performance. 

[*] Texts: We've removed the unintelligible garbage from the tutorials. 

[*] WMR Support: Controller bindings for WMR is now fixed.

[/olist]

[b]NEW ADDITIONS[/b]

[olist]
[*] Tutorial:
We've done a complete rework on our tutorial. The new tutorial features full voice-over, has a more simplistic approach and it's fun.

[*] Flavor:
We've added voice lines into the game. 


[*] Melee Combat & Weapon Holstering:
Melee combat adjustments made to damage/swing velocity balance. Now it feels more natural to hit something rather than killing air.

Weapon holstering is changed. To better visualize if your weapon is going to be stored or not now you'll see an outline of your weapon if you put it on your belt. 

The quick draw area is enlarged. With this picking up weapons from your holster will be much easier than before.
[/olist]

Once again we're very sorry about the rocky start. But as we said from day one this is a passion project for us, we're not disheartened and we're going to make Buried Alive: The Annihilation VR meet its full potential.

Thank you for sticking with us this far,

-The Two Ravens

notes.title: Beta Patch 1.0.6
notes.content:
[b]Experimental Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] The arm and hand logic is completely reworked. Now the arm and hand is a single mesh. Also now the hands can go through objects. However, the hands still act the same when they are holding an object.
[/list]

[b]News and Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Ammo pouches are moved to the belts
[*] Headshots and full-body explosion gives more points
[*] Now you can see an indicator of how many generators are there on the generators.
[*] Door texts are fixed
[*] Typos on the pages are fixed
[*] Generator handle collision bug is fixed
[*] Now added a smooth turn setting
[*] The shop is changed (once again)
[*] Now you can hold and drag zombies (now while moving with controller)
[*] Now you can chop off the zombies limbs 
[*] Now there is also a damage indicator on shields
[*] Unique upgrades to all ranged weapons
[*] Fixed the problem related to storing easter egg items
[*] Fixed the problem with randomly dropping the weapons
[/list]

notes.title: Beta Patch 1.0.2 is OUT!
notes.content:

[olist]

[*]    The L Motel: The L Motel is a new, narrow and dangerous area. There are some dark things around this place.
[/olist]
[*]  Overall map logistics have been changed.
[*]  NEW Catacombs: You now can use an ancient underground passage to roam around the world.
[*]  With the new wave system, some places got modified to be more user friendly with things like (Opening on the floor, broken walls, ...)
[/list]
